    "0846dcdf: .;\n.;Main entry point for editing an existing VISIT ENTRY subfile (#393.01).\n.;The SUBFILE DD contains a WORD-PROCESSING field which allows the\n.;creation of very large text nodes.\n.;\n.;If a valid existing Subfile entry is passed, then the SUBFILE DD will\n.;call this routine.\n.;\n.;On exit, a successful edit will file the edited text in the \n.;Subfile Multiple, as well as allow cross-references defined in the\n.;SUBFILE DD to execute.\n.;",
    "ea95d62b: ;Call the KERNEL routine that handles editing.",
    "7ad3ca17: ;Initialize variables needed for editing.",
    "60fcc61d: ;If the entry date exists in the 0 node, set the default editing date.",
    "45c85c27: ;Clean up and quit.",
    "96b18b44: ;Write the line label used for editing.",
    "a2f3a677: ;Quit.",
    "25e8fb60: ;Call the line editor and allow editing.",
    "a1a6d765: ;If the data is greater than 19 characters and not WORD-PROCESSING, use alternative reader.",
    "f6f24ad4: ;If not WORD-PROCESSING but is computed, don't allow editing.",
    "98846359: ;Read the edited line of text.",
    "936eb742: Quit if this is the end of the code.",
    "f8623d0b: Increment the counter for the current level of the code.",
    "3b998cc3: Go to the next level of the code.",
    "f4ea8f5e: If the code for this level has been executed before, go to the previous level and write/transfer data.",
    "c99beb48: If no value is entered, perform different actions based on the condition.",
    "26323fcc: If a question mark is entered, go to a specific section of the code. If a caret is entered, execute a specific routine.",
    "4782c9fd: If an at symbol is entered, execute a specific routine.",
    "9dffcf3c: If a space is entered and certain conditions are met, retrieve and display a stored value.",
    "168bda44: Execute different routines based on the input value and condition, and write/display the appropriate value.",
    "955d8c74: If the user enters multiple responses separated by semicolons, process each one and apply the Screen logic if it exists.",
    "355f555a: If there is no word-processing field, write the value from the entry without the piece containing the External value.",
    "594350d3: If the Data Validation is of type P (Pointer), set up call to the DICS^DIC lookup routine. If the Data Validation includes a file number (P124 for example), set DLAYGO so that new entries are created in that file. Call ^DIC and capture the Internal Value.",
    "83b8f819: If the Data Validation is not of type N (Numeric), branch to process other data types. Otherwise, check if the number has more than 24 decimal places and if so, reject the value.",
    "3c11bf38: If the Data Validation includes a decimal specification, format the number accordingly. Remove leading zeros, ensure the specified number of decimal places, and convert any trailing decimal portion to an integer if necessary.",
    "0a4ce97f: ;Initialize variables and kill data if required.",
    "c000bad9: ;Save user's response in ^DISV global if prompted. Exit if uparrow.",
    "80293f67: ;If invalid response, branch to error handling routine.",
    "4ab29f98: ;Set default error response.",
    "e54c79dc: ;Process user response.",
    "dc53515f: ;Set up data for current field being edited.",
    "b0b3e6be: ;Process data validation if required.",
    "9e2d61fc: ;Get external field value and execute computed code if present.",
    "a24e94f1: ;Resolve pointers to files if field is a pointer.",
    "46f13a15: ;Resolve MUMPS code pointers if field is a MUMPS code reference.",
    "8fa5250c: ;Execute data dictionary for special processing, resolve set of codes.",
    "be1166d5: ;If field X is populated, quit. Otherwise, get external value from input variable array. If not editing a word-processing field or multiple fields from a single template, branch to node for editing multiple fields.",
    "3c4587cd: ;If not an Internal or #-delimited external value, go to date response processing.",
    "4962ddcd: ;Call FileMan code to get external value. If external value populated, go to date response processing or prompt.",
    "e91b91e0: ;Quit.",
    "37abd7f4: ;Initialize mumps input template variables for template name and sequence number.",
    "2ceb9bee: ;Set variables for word-processing editing, validity conditions, up-arrow navigation, label, and field number.",
    "7f1f87e6: ;Branch to prompt editing node.",
    "77dac7ef: ;Prompt for date/time input, saving in X. Discard if invalid.",
    "a5e842fb: ;Quit.",
    "c3351154: ;If MUMPS instructions array is populated, create new instructions and dereference Y. Set sequence number and check response at X2. If null or up-arrow, restore previous value, else set LAYGO flow and jump to FileMan code to file data.",
    "ded28fe2: ;If response is null, clear all word-processing sub-field values.",
    "6ff95061: ;Quit if no input is received.",
    "081a1a99: ;If input is entered, execute the X3 line tag and handle branch logic based on the resulting value of Y.",
    "20907637: ;If no input is provided, set DGJTST and Y to indicate an incomplete entry.",
    "c1e83531: ;Quit if no input is received.",
    "bc9e3874: ;If input is entered, execute the X4 line tag and handle branch logic based on the resulting value of Y.",
    "531d111f: ;Set DGJTDDT to the corresponding date from the EVENT DATE or ADMISSION DATE field in file #393.",
    "4a21296f: ;Quit if no input is received.",
    "8196b1ae: ;If input is entered, execute the X5 line tag and handle branch logic based on the resulting value of Y.",
    "0d2f1681: ;If the input date is before DGJTDDT, clear the DATE field and display an error message; set Y to indicate an error.",
    "cfea1cac: ;Quit if no input is received.",
    "7bbde3a5: ;If input is received, branch execution to the ^DGJXE10 routine."
  ]
}
